title.narrative: Support for COVID-19 Emergency Response in Ethiopia

description.narrative: In response to the COVID-19 pandemic, the government of Ethiopia has strengthened its preparedness and response efforts and set up a national preparedness and response coordination mechanism through an Emergency Operation Center. As part of the response strengthening, the government of Ethiopia and the International Development Association have signed a bilateral agreement to prevent, detect and respond to the threat posed by COVID-19 and strengthen national systems for public health preparedness and response in Ethiopia. To achieve this objective, several strategies including public health education, Risk communication, COVID-19 testing, isolation, treatment, and vaccine deployment have been carried out throughout the country. \n\nThe deployment of COVID-19 Vaccination has been expanded, including in conflict-affected areas. UNOPS supports the Ministry of Health with the implementation of the COVID-19 vaccination deployment activities in the conflict-affected and security-constrained Tigray region.
